findings.claim: useProviders can expose provider data with defaultId undefined before the ProviderRegistry request has settled, breaking the promised combined providers/default-id result shape.
findings.evidence: The r4 verification note in acceptance_criteria says `useProviders` must combine list and default-registry state with `data only once both settle`; however the diff computes `const settled = list.data !== undefined && (registry.data !== null || registryError !== null);`, and because `registry.data` is initially `undefined`, `registry.data !== null` is true, so `data: settled ? value : undefined` can be returned while the registry is still loading.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the settled check to require an actual registry result or registry error, e.g. `const registrySettled = registry.data !== undefined || registryError !== null; const settled = list.data !== undefined && registrySettled;`, and keep `data` undefined until then.
